LogEntries.Entry: The relay satellite over <Alias=targetPlanet> went dark, and the settlers at the <Alias=DungeonLocation> have been cut off since. The replacement part never arrived. Raiders took it to the <Alias=FinalLocation>.

The relay over <Alias=targetPlanet> is dead and the settlers at the <Alias=DungeonLocation> can't call anyone. Their replacement part was taken by raiders at the <Alias=FinalLocation>. I said I'd get it and fit it.
The raiders' leader at the <Alias=FinalLocation> had the transceiver core. I took it back. It needs fitting in the relay satellite over <Alias=targetPlanet>.
I've got the Goods Package. It goes to <Alias=FinalLocation> on <Alias=targetPlanet>, whenever I'm heading that way.

The relay over <Alias=targetPlanet> went dark and raiders at the <Alias=FinalLocation> had its replacement core. I got it back and fitted it in orbit. The settlers at the <Alias=DungeonLocation> can call out again.

Objectives.DisplayText: Talk to the settler at the <Alias=DungeonLocation>
Recover the transceiver core from the <Alias=FinalLocation>
Fit the transceiver core in the relay satellite

Lines.ResponseText: Our relay satellite's dead, and we can't call anyone.
The new core for it got taken by raiders on the way here.
If you've got a ship, you're the most useful person I've seen all week.
I'll get the part and fit it.
It's a transceiver core, about the size of a toolbox.
Fit it in the satellite and we're back on the network.
I'd do it myself if I could fly.
What's wrong with the satellite?
The core burned out. They do, after a few years up there.
Everything else on it is fine. Swap the core and it wakes up.
Why does it matter so much?
No relay, no calls.
No supply runs, no weather warnings, no doctor.
We've been shouting at the sky for nine days.
Could you rig something in the meantime?
I tried. The dish down here can hear the satellite fine. It just won't answer. It's the core or nothing.
Watch your step. The dish cables run everywhere.
This is a short-range set, so if you can hear me, you're close.
Our relay's dead and we can't call out.
We need someone with a ship.
Wait, is that you? You got it?
Then it's the satellite with no lights on. You can't miss it.
Well, you can. Please don't.
There it is. We can hear the whole sky again.
First call I've made in nine days, and it's to say thank you.
